parameter_provenance.legs: 4 legs give 3 interior turns, the frozen G10 minimum
parameter_provenance.min_anchor_separation_m: 3 x the frozen 1.0 m G10 separator, so a separator run has room either side of it
parameter_provenance.max_anchor_separation_m: keeps summed legs within the frozen max_path_m
parameter_provenance.min_anchor_turn_deg: the frozen turn magnitude from the collection contract; a smaller bend cannot produce an admissible event
parameter_provenance.max_anchor_turn_deg: 135 degrees. A bend approaching 180 is a reversal along the same corridor rather than a region transition, and the spacing rules alone do not forbid it.

budget_meaning: 96 ATTEMPTS, not 96 successful constructions. Inherited from the earlier Hospital populations, which loop over the budget and record a generator failure as a consumed index.
claim_boundaries: kinematic collection establishes no drivetrain fidelity
